title: After getting shot in February, 49ers DE Keion White is good to go

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: After getting shot in February, 49ers DE Keion White is good to go
sources.description: The very strange 2026 for the 49ers included the February shooting of defensive end Keion White in a San Francisco bar and nightclub, which reportedly happened after the rapper Lil Baby and White got into an argument when Lil Baby's entourage tried to enter White's private party.
